'''Ithcharaka''' was a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] of the [[Nevoota/Legends|Nevoota]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Ithcharaka led the Nevoota in [[Nevoota Extinction|war]] against the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], but eventually lost after a four-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] struggle. The Nevoota were then made extinct.<ref name="Codex" />
